Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase after a short break. The players have made their way out to the field. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers will take the responsibility of opening the innings for West Indies. Trent Boult will begin proceedings with the new ball. Lets go...
... RUN CHASE ...

Right then, we shall return shortly with the run chase. West Indies will take this as an opportunity to build some consistency and get into a winning habit. They would have learned a lot from the game and will look to apply that here. They should be able to achieve this target with the batting lineup they have at their disposal. New Zealand will have to come out with fire and take some early wickets to put the pressure on their opponents. The pitch has a lot of help for the bowlers and they need to be disciplined if they are to exploit it. Will they be able to defend this target and level the series? Or will the hosts seal a rare series win? We will find out soon.

The West Indies pace bowlers were amazing in the Powerplay this time around as Jason Holder picked up two and Alzarri Joseph took one to peg the Kiwis on the back foot right away. The spinners bowled with control but could not take a wicket for a period of time. However, once the partnership between Daryl Mitchell and Finn Allen was broken, the floodgates were opened and wickets began to tumble freely. Kevin Sinclair is proving to be quite a handful and was the pick of the bowlers as he took four wickets for 41 runs. Jason Holder took three crucial wickets and conceded just 24 runs in his 9 overs with Akeal Hosein chipping in with two. They will be slightly disappointed that they did not take the last wicket sooner and close the game out. This should be a routine run chase for the West Indies batters and will look to seal this series with a game to spare.

The visitors got off to a poor start losing Martin Guptill really early and with the dismissal of Devon Conway and Tom Latham soon after, found themselves three-wicket down with just 31 runs on the board. An 84-run partnership between Finn Allen and Daryl Mitchell helped them recover slightly but they lost Mitchell just before rain halted play. The break seemed to have distracted the Kiwis, as they lost 6 wickets for 80 runs and it was the last wicket partnership of 31 between Mitchell Santner and Trent Boult that pushed them beyond the 200-run mark. Daryl Mitchell played well for his 41 but it was Finn Allen’s innings that proved to be the saving grace for the visitors. He fell 4 short of what would have been in his maiden ODI century. The bowlers will have to come out and do better than they did last time if they are to defend an under-par total.

New Zealand have been unable to play out their 50 overs once again! West Indies have put on another fine bowling display and this could well revolutionize cricket for this sport-loving nation! They have had a stranglehold on the visitors through this entire innings and never allowed them to break free. The Kiwis will be really disappointed with their batting effort and this is not a good time for them to lose form with the T20 World Cup just around the corner. They have just 212 on the board and have made the task difficult for their bowlers.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tossed up, slightly shorter too, Trent Boult comes down the track to loft it but gets a top edge. The ball goes high up in the air and towards Kevin Sinclair was takes a brilliant catch. New Zealand are all out for 212 runs.
Tossed up outside off, Mitchell Santner hits it to covers for one.
Goes full again and on middle, Trent Boult works it towards mid-wicket. This partnership can hurt the Windies.
Fuller one and on middle, Mitchell Santner drives it towards long on for one.

FOUR! Fine shot! Jason Holder serves this on a length and around off, Mitchell Santner goes on his back foot and punches it towards the deep extra cover fence for a boundary. He is playing a good hand here.
A slower ball, full and on middle, angling in, Mitchell Santner ushes it back to the bowler.
Pulls his length back a bit and there is width on offer, on off, Trent Boult clears his front leg and lofts it towards the vacant deep extra cover region for a triple.
Full and on middle, Mitchell Santner drills it down to long on for a single.
This is almost on a yorker length and outside off, Trent Boult opens the face of his bat and squeezes it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Another length delivery and on off, Trent Boult dabs it towards point and denies for the run straightaway.
This is on a good length and around off, Trent Boult has a wild swing at it but misses it completely.
In the blockhole and on middle, Mitchell Santner digs it out towards mid off for a quick single. 200 up!
On a length and on off, Mitchell Santner moves across to play it but misses and gets hit on the pads.

This is short and on middle, Mitchell Santner pulls it towards deep mid wicket and calls for two, the fielder there has shy at the bowler's end and hits it. The umpire goes upstairs to check and the replay shows that Boult was well in.
FOUR! Good shot! This is flighted, full and on middle, Trent Boult slogs it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary. They need a lot more of that to get to a decent score.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Mitchell Santner eases it towards long on for one.
Flatter and quciker again, on off, Mitchell Santner tries to cut it but gets beaten by the pace.
Floated, full and on off, Trent Boult drags it towards long on for a single.

Just short! This is tossed up and around off, Mitchell Santner again throws his bat at it but this time gets a thick outside edge towards short third man, the fielder there dives forwards but collects it on the bounce. The umpires goes upstairs to check the catch and the soft signal is not out. The replay confirms that it has indeed fallen short of the fielder.
Quicker one, short and on off, turning away, Mitchell Santner slashes at it but misses it.
This one lands on middle, Trent Boult eases it to mid off.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Trent Boult plays an upper cut towards third man for a boundary.
On middle, blocked out.
On a length and on off, Mitchell Santner drives it to covers for one.
Fuller again, outside off, Trent Boult drives it to covers. They run for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the non strikers end. A direct hit and Boult was a goner.
Fuller and on middle, Mitchell Santner drills it to long off for one.
This one lands outside off, Mitchell Santner drives it to covers for one.
Fuller and down the middle, Trent Boult plays it to mid off .
Trent Boult is the last batter to make his way out the middle.
OUT! BOWLED! Tossed up on middle with a hint of turn, Tim Southee looks to block it but misses. The ball clips over the off pole. New Zealand are now 181/9.
Tossed up on middle, Tim Southee looks to drive it but gets an outside edge as the ball rolls towards the off side. They collect two.
Tossed up, around off, Santner drives it to covers for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Mitchell Santner punches it to covers for one.
On off, defended out.
Serves it outside off, Santner drives it to long off for one.
SIX! Shorter and down the middle, Santner bangs it over long off for a maximum.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Santner punches it to long on for one.
Fuller and on the stumps, Tim Southee moves to his off side and flicks it to backward square leg for one. Risky shot!
Fuller and on off, Mitchell Santner eases it to mid off for one.
Slightly shorter, around off, Mitchell Santner punches it to id off for one.
Bowls it on middle and fuller in length, Mitchell Santner blocks it back towards the bowler.
This one lands fuller and on off, Tim Southee knocks it to long on for one.
On off, defended out.
Tim Southee makes his way out to the middle and New Zealand may not reach the 200 mark once again.

OUT! CAUGHT-BEHIND! Kevin Sinclair with the dream dismissal for an off spinner. This is tossed up, full and on the fifth stump line, inviting the batter forward. James Neesham obliges and leans on to block it but the turn away takes a thin outside edge, Shai Hope behind the stumps takes a nice catch moving to his left. The break has surely worked for the Windies and they are dictating terms here.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Kevin Sinclair

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and outside off, defended.
Fuller and on off, this is guided towards deep point for one.
On a length and outside off, Mitchell Santner cuts it to point for one.
Fuller one on off, this is flicked towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length and on off, Mitchell Santner eases it to mid off. Dot.
On a length and outside off, left alone.
Mitchell Santner is the next batter in for New Zealand.

OUT! BOWLED! Jason Holder gets the man in form. Finn Allen misses out on his maiden ODI hundred by a whisker. This one lands outside off, on a length, sticks to the surface a bit. Finn Allen looks to play at it but the ball keeps low and he only manages to get an inside edge as the ball then shatter the stumps. Finn Allen walks out after a brilliant knock! New Zealand are in real trouble now. They will be having flashbacks of the first ODI. Can they go past the 200 mark this time?
Darts this one on middle, James Neesham uses his feet and yorks himself, he manages to tuck it towards mid-wicket.
Again tries the reverse sweep on this full delivery but finds short third man again.
Floated and on middle, James Neesham reverse sweeps it but straight to the short third man fielder.
Tossed up, full and on off, James Neesham blocks it towards covers.
A bit short and on leg, Finn Allen works this of his inner half towards long on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Akeal Hosein gets his second wicket. Akeal Hosein bowls it fuller, on middle. Glenn Phillips looks to sweep it but the extra bounce gets the top edge of his willow. The ball goes in the air and carries towards Nicholas Pooran who takes it at covers. Glenn Phillips cannot make the most of his oppurtunity and will be kicking himself. James Neesham comes out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Maiden over! This is on a length and on middle, angling in, Finn Allen blocks it out.

UPPISH BUT SAFE! Jason Holder takes the pace out of and bowls this on a good length, Finn Allen goes for the pull but checks his shot at the last moment. The ball takes the top edge but falls short of the mid off fielder.
Jason Holder with the extra bounce again. This is on a hard length and on off, skids through, Finn Allen looks to play at it but gets hit on the shoulder and the ball deflects towards point.
Brilliant fielding! Jason Holder bangs this short and on middle, keeps a bit low, Finn Allen still manags to pull it towards mid-wicket where Shamarh Brooks dives to his left to stop it.
Length again but this time on middle, Finn Allen looks to block it but gets an outside edge towards point.
This is on a hard length and on off, Finn Allen stays back and guides it towards point.
Floated and around middle, Glenn Phillips pushes this back to the bowler.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! This is again short and on middle, Glenn Phillips goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Goes short and on off, turning away, Glenn Phillips makes room and cuts it wide of the deep point fielder for a brace.
Another full delivery, on middle, Finn Allen drives it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Glenn Phillips blocks it out.
Floated, short and outside off, Finn Allen cuts it through cover-point for a single.
EXTRA BOUNCE! This is on a hard length and on middle, skids through the surface, Glenn Phillips looks to block it but gets hit on the gloves due to the extra bounce.
Bangs in a short ball and on off, Finn Allen stays back and pulls it away in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Another good-length delivery and this time on middle, Finn Allen knocks it towards mid-wicket with soft hands.
Jason Holder continues bowling on a length and on off, Finn Allen goes back pushes this towards covers.
WIDE! Jason Holder bangs in a bouncer and on middle, Finn Allen ducks under it. It is called a wide for height.
This is on a hard length and around off, Glenn Phillips opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for a single.
On a length and onto the pads, Glenn Phillips stays back and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Short this time and outside off, Glenn Phillips guides this towards third man for a single and will keep strike. End of a successful over from Akeal Hosein!
Flights this one full and outside off, Glenn Phillips blocks this towards cover.
This is a touch short and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips goes on the back foot and fends the ball back to the bowler.
Akeal Hosein serves this one full and outside off, Finn Allen places this towards point.

OUT! CAUGHT! Akeal Hosein gets his first wicket and Michael Bracewell has to depart! Akeal Hosein floats a delivery full and outside off, Michael Bracewell goes for the slog sweep and gets a top edge that flies towards deep square leg. Shamarh Brooks makes the catch look easy and New Zealand have now lost half their side. Akeal Hosein looks thrilled and he should be as he has bowled really well in this game as well.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Akeal Hosein is a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen pulls this to deep square leg and they have to settle for a single.
Alzarri Joseph is a touch short once again and bowls this outside off, Finn Allen cuts this to deep point and takes a run to keep strike.
This is served on a good length and just outside off, Finn Allen looks to drive on the back foot but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Alzarri Joseph follows up with another short ball angling down leg, Michael Bracewell pulls this toward fine leg and the ball falls just short of the diving fielder. They take a single.
Michael Bracewell gets hit on the helmet. The physios are in for the mandatory concussion check. Everything looks fine now and we are good to go...

Alzarri Joseph bangs this in short and aims for the batter. Michael Bracewell goes for the pull but misses. Michael Bracewell gets hit straight on the helmet. That looked bad and the physios are called out.
This is bowled on a good length and outside off, Finn Allen taps the ball to the off side with soft hands and they rush across for a single. The bowler is not happy.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this into the pads on a good length, Michael Bracewell clips the ball to fine leg for a run.
This is a touch short and outside off, Finn Allen uses the crease and hits the ball to deep cover. A misfield allows them to take a couple of runs.
Loopy delivery bowled full and straight. Finn Allen gets a stride forward and plays it back to the bowler.
Bowls this on a middle stump line and full, Finn Allen defends this and gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Flights this one full and outside off, Finn Allen knocks the ball to cover.
Bowls this a bit short and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and plays this wide of long on for a couple of runs.
Akeal Hosein strays onto the pads on a fuller length, Michael Bracewell clips this to fine leg for a single.

SIX! This has been deposited over the boundary! Alzarri Joseph bowls this on a shorter length and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen gets inside the line of the ball and helps it over deep backward square leg for six runs.
Alzarri Joseph goes a touch fuller and outside off, Michael Bracewell gets a thickish outside edge to third man for a single.
What a delivery from Alzarri Joseph! He serves this back of a length and gets the ball to nip back into the batter. Michael Bracewell gets beaten on the inside edge.
Alzarri Joseph goes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and bowls this full and outside off. Michael Bracewell strokes this straight to mid off.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this straight in line with the stumps from a good length, Finn Allen clips this towards fine leg for a single.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this one good length and outside off, Finn Allen defends this towards point.

UPDATE - 2.56 am IST (9.26 pm GMT, previous day) - Finally some good news! The rain seems to have stopped and the dark clouds have drifted away. The sky looks bright now and the covers are coming off. The groundstaff has already begun mopping up the outfield and they are as eager as were are for the game to resume soon. The umpires have completed their inspection and the game is set to resume at 3.20 am IST (9.50 pm GMT, previous day). Do join us soon for the restart.

UPDATE - 2.46 am IST (9.16 pm GMT, previous day) - This has been a considerable delay, and still no good news to share with you folks. Looks like we are headed for a shortened game if this rain persists. The game was moving along nicely till this interruption and let's hope this rain relents. Fingers crossed.

Akeal Hosein had a chat before the game with the broadcasters. He said that his role for the team is to take wickets. He praised the two debutants of the previous game (Yannic Cariah and Kevin Sinclair) for their bowling performance in that match. He added that when the pitch is offering something to the spinners, it is still key to bowl in the right areas and most importantly attack the stumps. He ended by saying that he enjoys bowling in different situations and tries to bowl according to them. That said, he has done well so far in this game and has been disciplined but is yet to take a wicket.

UPDATE - 2.09 am IST (8.39 pm GMT, previous day) - It does not look good as the rain is pouring down now. This will definitely wet the outfield and even if the rain stops soon it may take time to dry the playing area. It has gotten really dark out there and this seems like a considerable delay. We can have 90 minutes of stoppage before overs start to get deducted. Let's hope we get some cricketing action soon.

UPDATE - 1.54 am IST (8.24 pm GMT, previous day) - There is some rain around the ground at the moment. The covers are on and the players are going off. Oh..no! The rain seems to have gotten heavier now. But we hope that it is just a passing shower and it gets clear soon. Stay tuned for further updates.

Drinks! After the start the West Indies got, they could not make the most out of it. Finn Allen ​​​​and Daryl Mitchell built up a nice partnership and took the Kiwis out of trouble. Mitchell was looking good but he got dismissed. Finn Allen, on the other hand has found his touch and got to his half-century after early struggles. West Indies need to get his wicket quickly to put more pressure on them. An exciting session awaits. Wait a moment... The rain gods seem to have made an appearance here.
Kevin Sinclair floats this one full and outside the off pole. Michael Bracewell blocks this towards cover. Just two runs of this over!
Kevin Sinclair bowls this a touch short and outside off, Michael Bracewell thumps this straight to covers.
Kevin Sinclair bowls this full once again on middle and off, Michael Bracewell shimmies down the wicket and knocks this back to the bowler.
Bowls this full in line with the stumps, Michael Bracewell defends this back down the pitch.
This is full and on middle, Michael Bracewell clips this to mid-wicket.
Kevin Sinclair fires this on in full and angling into the stumps, Michael Bracewell looks to defend and gets an outside edge to third man for a couple of runs.
FOUR! SMASHED! This is agian short and on middle, Finn Allen slaps it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. A good finish to the over.
SIX! All the way! This is short again and on middle and leg, Finn Allen shuffles across and hooks it over the deep backward square leg for a biggie.
Full and around off, Finn Allen moves across and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Alzarri Joseph bangs this one short and on middle, Finn Allen ducks under it.
Length and on off, Finn Allen bunts it onto the ground.

Alzarri Joseph starts with a hard length delivery and on the leg stump, Michael Bracewell looks to flick it away but gets it of his gloves towards the keeper. Shai Hope is standing a bit too behind and cannot grab it as it just falls short. The batter takes a run as it goes past the keeper. It is given as leg byes.
Alzarri Joseph comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Nice timing! This is just a touch short and on leg, Finn Allen flicks it away towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary. A wicket and two boundaries in this over.
Michael Bracewell comes out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kevin Sinclair gets his man! He is thrilled and celebrates with cartwheels and summersaults! He flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell charges down the wicket and looks to heave this leg side. He gets an inside edge that flies high towards deep square leg. Akeal Hosein is in position to complete a routine catch and Daryl Mitchell has to make the long walk back. West Indies finally have the breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Kevin Sinclair

Commentary.Commentary: Kevin Sinclair keeps bowling this full and outside off, The reverse sweep finds short third man this time.

Kevin Sinclair floats this one outside off, Daryl Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep once again and this fall just short of cover. He can not stop the ball and the ball goes to the deep as they take two runs.
Floated full outside off, Daryl Mitchell knocks this towards cover.

FOUR! The reverse sweep comes off this time! Kevin Sinclair persists with the full delivery outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets this to the right of short third man and finds the deep backward point fence for four more runs.

FOUR! This has been thumped! Yannic Cariah goes full once again and outside off, Finn Allen has room to swing his arms and hits this straight to long off for a boundary. The fielder at long off has no chance to get this as it has been hit with great power.
Yannic Cariah continues to flight this full and this time just outside off, Finn Allen is early into his block and the ball drops into the pitch.
Flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen gets his front foot ahead and blocks this to the left of the bowler.
Bowls this a fraction short as well and keeps it straight, Finn Allen defends this back down the pitch towards the leg side.
This is a touch short and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen gets low and pulls this towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Yannic Cariah serves this full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell taps this with soft hands towards point and takes a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell revers sweeps it through point for one.
On off, kept out.
This is tossed up, full and on off, Finn Allen moves across and paddles it away towards fine leg for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Finn Allen knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Short and around off, Daryl Mitchell stays back and guides it to point for a single.
Fires this one in full and on off, Finn Allen makes room and cuts it past point for a run.
A bit short and on leg, Daryl Mitchell comes down the track and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell tries the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit high on his body.
BEATEN! This is slower through the air and on off, turning away, Daryl Mitchell gets beaten on the outside edge as he goes to block it.

This is looped up, on off, Daryl Mitchell knocks it towards point. Finn Allen sets off for the run but Mitchell sends him back midway. Akeal Hosein picks up the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses and Allen gets home.
Floated, full and on off, Finn Allen drives it towards long off for a single.
Flighted delivery and on off, turning away, Finn Allen tries to cut it but gets a bottom edge and the ball goes between the keeper's leg towards the third man region. Two runs taken.
Shortish again and down the leg, Finn Allen flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short and on the pads, Daryl Mitchell stays back and works it through square leg for one.
Another full delivery and on off, Daryl Mitchell this time connects his reverse sweep but hits it straight to short third man.
Floated, full and around off, Daryl Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep but cannot connect and gets hit on his body.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell tucks it to the leg side.
Flatter and on middle, Finn Allen eases it towards long on for one.

That is a well-made half-century by Finn Allen! Yannic Cariah bowls this a touch short and angling into the stumps, Finn Allen works this to deep mid-wicket and takes a single to bring up his fifty. New Zealand will be hoping he carries on to score big.
Flighted delivery bowled full and well outside off, Daryl Mitchell sweeps this towards deep square leg for a single.
Floats this one full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell leaves this one alone.
Yannic Cariah bowls this short and wide outside off, Finn Allen cuts this to deep point for a single.
Yannic Cariah bowls this full on middle and off, Daryl Mitchell knocks this towards long on for a run.
Yannic Cariah begins with a short ball outside off, Finn Allen lobs his pull towards long on and they take a single.
Kevin Sinclair bowls a quicker delivery fired into the pads, Finn Allen clips this to deep backward square leg for a single.
Kevin Sinclair bowls this full and really close to off stumps, Finn Allen looks to pull this but the ball stays low and just misses the off pole. That was close.
Third reverse sweep in a row and he hits a full delivery in line with the stumps to deep point for a single.
Kevin Sinclair bowls this full and closer to the stumps, Daryl Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep once again and gets a bottom edge towards fine leg for a brace.
This one is full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell goes for his favored reverse sweep and gets this to the right of short third man for a couple of runs.
Kevin Sinclair starts with a full delivery angling into the pads, Finn Allen works this to deep mid-wicket for a single. That brings up the fifty-run partnership between these two.
Kevin Sinclair replaces Akeal Hosein.
Goes a bit short and outside off, Daryl Mitchell mistimes his shot straight to cover and shouts out in diappointment.
Continues bowling full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell defends this solidly to the left of the bowler.
Flighted delivery full and on off, Finn Allen looks to work this towards the leg side but gets a leading edge to deep cover for a single.
Full once again and just outside off, Finn Allen pushes at it and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Yannic Cariah bowls a loopy delivery outside off, Finn Allen looks to hit this aerially to the offside but slices this towards deep cover-point. They take a couple of runs.
Yannic Cariah gets the ball to come back in sharply from a fuller length and outside off, Finn Allen looks to defend and gets beaten on the inside edge.
Floated full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets a stride forward and looks to block. Gets beaten on the outside edge.
Akeal Hosein is a touch short but straight. Finn Allen whips this towards deep mid-wicket for single.
This is short and outside off, Finn Allen cuts this to deep backward point and takes two runs.

FOUR! Short this time and swatted away! Akeal Hosein pulls his length back and serves this outside off, Finn Allen uses the depth of the crease and dismisses it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for four useful runs.
This is full as well and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell clips this to long on for a single.
Akeal Hosein flights this one full and just outside  off, Daryl Mitchell pushes at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes short and outside off, Daryl Mitchell cuts this to deep point for a single.
Flighted full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep once again and finds short third man this time as well.
Floats this one full and outside the off stumps, Daryl Mitchell blocks this towards cover.
FOUR! This as been put away! Yannic Cariah is short this time and outside off, Daryl Mitchell rocks back and pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Yannic Cariah goes full this time outside off, Daryl Mitchell reverse sweeps this straight to short third man.
Yannic Cariah bowls this really short and angling into the stumps, Finn Allen misses out as he miscues his pull towards short fine leg takes a single.
Slower through the air and on leg, Daryl Mitchell blocks it onto the pitch.
Tossed up, lands short and on off, Daryl Mitchell slaps it wide of long off for a brace.
A bit short and on middle, Finn Allen stays back and clips it towards mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Finn Allen is looking to break the shackles here but Akeal Hosein won't mind that. This is looped up and on middle, Finn Allen skips down the track and lofts it over long off for a biggie.
Floated, short again and on off, Finn Allen punches it towards extra cover.
Short and on off, turning away, Finn Allen goes for the cut but bunts it onto the ground. He is really struggling to score runs here.
Fuller one and around off, Daryl Mitchell pushes it towards covers.
BEATEN! This is looped up and outside off, turning away sharply, Daryl Mitchell leans on to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floated, full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell blocks it out.
Full and on off, Finn Allen drives it towards long off for one.

An appeal for a catch but turned down. This is tossed up and around middle, Finn Allen goes for the revers sweep but misses and the ball lobs up of his forearm and goes behind the keeper. The slip moves there and takes the catch. They appeal for it but the finger stays down.
Flighted, full and on off, turning away, Finn Allen looks to defend but gets it of his outer half towards point.
Goes back to bowling full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell happy to defend this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this a fraction short and angling into the stumps, Daryl Mitchell rocks back and guides the ball towards point.
Draws an outside edge. Akeal Hosein serves this full and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell looks to block and gets and thickish edge on the bounce to the right of first slip.
SIX! BANG!  Akeal Hosein loops this one up and bowls this on middle, Daryl Mitchell skips down the track and smashes it over the bowler's head for a maximum.

Tossed up, full and on off, turning away, Daryl Mitchell goes for the sweep but misses. Shai Hope collects and takes the bails off and appeals for the stumping. The umpire sends it upstairs and the replays shows that Daryl Mitchell got his foot back in time. He survives.
Floated, lands short and on middle, Finn Allen tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A short delivery and outside off, Finn Allen cuts it to deep point for one. No maiden then.
Make that five dots! This is tossed up and on off, Finn Allen goes for the reverse sweep but gets it of his gloves towards the slip.
Four dots on the trot! This is quciker again, on middle, Finn Allen pushes it back to the bowler.
A brilliant stop at covers! This floated and around off, Finn Allen punches it to the right of covers but the fielder dives and stops it. Another dot.
Quicker one, short and on middle, Finn Allen goes for the cut but gets hurried by the pace and gets an inside edge past his stumps.
Yannic Cariah starts with a ripper! This is tossed up, full and on off, turning away a shy bit, Finn Allen leans on to block but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Yannic Cariah has been brought into the attack. It will now most likely be spin from both ends.
Looped up, full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell knocks it down the pitch.
Flatter and quicker, on off, Finn Allen goes on his back foot and cuts it through cover-point for one.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle, turning a bit, Finn Allen looks to defend it but gets a leading edge towards covers.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Finn Allen leans on and blocks it out.
Short again and on middle, Daryl Mitchell makes room and punches it off the back foot through covers for a run.
A bit short and on off, turning away, Finn Allen stays back slaps it down to long off for a single.

Drinks! This has been a dominating performance by West Indies with the ball! They were finding it difficult to put up a decent bowling performance in the recent past and now they have done so in two consecutive games. New Zealand's batting has been in outstanding form all summer but has failed to take off in this ODI series. They have lost three wickets and have a massive job on their hands here. West Indies will introduce their spinners in the middle overs and the battle is only going to get more intense.

Alzarri Joseph bowls this one short and angling into the batter. Finn Allen fends this awkwardly and the ball balloons to the left of the keeper and they take a single. Just one run from this over then. Alzarri Joseph is looking in fine rhythm.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Finn Allen looks to pull but the ball stays a bit low. Gets beaten on the bottom edge and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Goes a touch fuller this time and outside off, Finn Allen strokes this firmly and a good stop by Yannic Cariah at cover prevents a run.
Alzarri Joseph bangs this one in short and bowls this outside off, Finn Allen ducks well under this one.
Alzarri Joseph serves this one wide outside off and on a good length, Finn Allen miscues his shot towards cover.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this on a good length and keeps to the outside off stump line. Finn Allen plays this back towards the bowler.
Akeal Hosein continues bowling full and just outside off, Daryl Mitchell defends this solidly down the pitch. 5 dot balls and a maximum in this over.
Beaten! Gets the ball to turn sharply after pitching outside off on a fuller length. Daryl Mitchell pushes at the ball and does not get bat on it.
Goes full once again and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell knocks this back to the bowler.
Floated, full and on off, Daryl Mitchell blocks it out towards covers.
SIX! Daryl Mitchell gets his first maximum of the innings! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell dances down the track and lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Flighted delivery and on off, turning away a bit, Daryl Mitchell leans on and pushes it off the outer half of his bat towards point.
Goes full on the pads, Finn Allen clips this straight to mid-wicket. End of another good over from Alzarri Joseph as just 3 runs have come off it.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this one slightly short as well and outside off, Daryl Mitchell guides this to deep backward point for a single.

Alzarri Joseph bowls this back of a length and angling down leg, Daryl Mitchell looks to glance this but misses. There is a huge appeal and the umpire does not call this wide so it must have hit something. West Indies decide to review this. UltraEdge shows a spike when the ball passes the bat but the umpire reckons there is a gap between bat and ball. The ball definitely grazes past the body. The on-field decision remains and Daryl Mitchell survives.
Continues bowling on a good length, and just outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets across the stumps and taps the ball back towards the bowler.
This is straying onto the pads from a good length, Finn Allen works this towards wide fine leg and takes one.
The first runs off Alzarri Joseph! He bowls this back of a length and angles into the batter. Daryl Mitchell looks to fend and gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Bowls this full and on middle, Finn Allen strokes this back to the bowler. A maiden to start off for Akeal Hosein!
Make that five! Akeal Hosein goes full outside off, Finn Allen finds the cover fielder once again.
Bowls this is line with the stumps and full, Finn Allen knocks this back down the pitch. Four dot balls now.
Full this time and outside off, Finn Allen strokes this straight to short cover.
Bowls this a touch short and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen goes back in the crease and hits this back to the bowler's left.
Akeal Hosein begins with a full delivery angling into the stumps, Finn Allen defends this towards cover.
We will see spin for the first time as Akeal Hosein comes into the attack.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this a touch wider outside off on a good length. Daryl Mitchell is watchful as he leaves this one alone as well. Another maiden over from Alzarri Joseph!
Alzarri Joseph serves this one a good length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell is happy to let this one go.
Pulls his length back a fraction, and bowls this just outside off stump, Daryl Mitchell looks to defend and there is some extra bounce. Gets hit high on the bat and the ball rolls to square leg.
Alzarri Joseph bangs this one in short and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell ducks under this one.
Angles this one into the batter from a good length, Daryl Mitchell flicks this towards mid-wicket.
Alzarri Joseph is right on the money bowling this on a good length and just outside off, Daryl Mitchell fends this back down the wicket.
End of Powerplay 1 and now West Indies can keep four fielders outside the inner circle. They will want to keep the pressure on though.
Another sharp bouncer. Jason Holder lands it short and on off, angling in sharply, Daryl Mitchell gets across to defend it but the ball hits his gloves and goes towards sqaure leg. They cross.
Jason Holder welcomes Daryl Mitchell with a sharp bouncer. This is short and on middle, angling in, Daryl Mitchell ducks under it.
Daryl Mitchell makes his way out to the middle with New Zealand in some serious trouble.

OUT! TAKEN! This is absolutely brilliant captaincy by Nicholas Pooran. He put in 7 fielders on the off side for Latham and that plan has worked. Jason Holder bowls this back of a length and outside off, gets some extra bounce on it as well. Tom Latham looks to steer it but gets a bit surprised by the bounce. As a result, the ball takes the top edge and goes  in the air and straight to Kevin Sinclair at backward point who makes no mistake. Tom Latham has to go back for a duck and West Indies are on top here.
Commentary.Howout: c Kevin Sinclair b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: This is again on a length and on off, Tom Latham cuts it from his crease but straight to point.
A bit short and on the leg stump, Finn Allen looks to flick it but misses and the ball defelcts of his thigh pad towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
This is on a good length and on middle, keeps a bit low too, Finn Allen does well to put his bat down in time and defend it.
On a length and on off, Tom Latham stays back and blocks it out.
The skipper Tom Latham makes his way to the crease and will be looking to play a Kane Williamson innings and steady the ship here.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Alzarri Joseph gets his 22nd wicket at this venue. This is on a hard length and on the fifth stump line, Devon Conway looks to push it away to the off side but closes the face of his bat a bit too soon. The ball takes the inside edge and crashes onto the stumps. New Zealand lose their second wicket.
This is on length and on middle, Devon Conway gets hurried by the pace and gets hit on his gloves while trying to block it.

Excellent stop by Shai Hope! This is full and outside off, Devon Conway slashes at it but gets an inside edge past his stumps and towards the right of the keeper. Shai Hope dives in that direction and makes a good stop. He certainly saved a boundary there.
Length again and on middle this time, Devon Conway stays there and blocks it onto the pitch.
Alzarri Joseph starts with a good length delivery from 'round the wicket, on off, Devon Conway knocks it towards backward point.
Alzarri Joseph has been brought into the attack. He is the leading wicket-taker at this venue and will be looking take some more here.
On a hard length and on middle, Finn Allen tucks it towards sqaure leg.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Finn Allen hops up and blocks it out.
Jason Holder goes full again and n off, Devon Conway takes a couple of steps down the track and guides it towards third man for a single.
Full delivery and on off, Devon Conway drives it on the up and the ball goes towards covers on a bounce.
Length again and outside off, Devon Conway offers no shot at it.
This is on a good length and around off, angling away, Devon Conway leaves it alone.
Full and on off, Devon Conway knocks it towards mid off and gets across for a quick single.

A good-length delivery and on middle, Devon Conway looks to block it but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a stiffled appeal for the LBW but turned down. Nicholas Pooran decides against the review.
Overthrows! This is on a length and on off, Finn Allen pushes it to point, the fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but there is no one backing up. The batters take a run.
Fullish one and on middle, Finn Allen flicks it uppishly but it falls short of the short mid-wicket fielder.
Full and around off, Finn Allen bunts it onto the ground.

FOUR! Nice shot! This is just a touch short and on middle, Finn Allen gets into position qucikly and pulls it towards the deep sqaure leg fence. Kevin Sinclair there puts in a dive but his knee gets stuck in the ground and the ball goes over the fence for a boundary.
Full and on middle, Finn Allen tucks it wide of the mid on fielder and takes a single.
A slower one now, on a length and on middle, Finn Allen look to flick it but gets beaten due to the change of pace and gets hit on his thigh pads.
Full again and on middle, Finn Allen works it away through square leg with soft hands and comes back for the second.
Goes a bit full and around off, Devon Conway opens the face of his bat and guides it past point for a single.
Length again and on the fifth stump line, Devon Conway pushes it to the right of the bowler. No run taken.
Jason Holder comes 'round the wicket and bowls a length delivery, on off, Devon Conway stays there and blocks it out.
Kyle Mayers ends with a good-length delivery outside off, Finn Allen defends the ball back to the left of the bowler.
Kyle Mayers goes back to bowling on a good length and angles this into the stumps, Finn Allen clips the ball towards mid-wicket.

This is poor work on the field. Kyle Mayers bowls a fuller delivery in line with the stumps, Finn Allen taps the ball to the right of the bowler with soft hands. Long on is in place and he is slow to come for the ball. They steal a second.
Serves this on a good length and just outside off, Devon Conway gets a thickish outside edge towards deep backward point for a single.
Beaten! Kyle Mayers delivers this on a good length and the ball moves away from the left-hander with the angle after pitching on off. Devon Conway pushes at it and beats his outside edge.
Kyle Mayers bowls this full and onto the pads, Devon Conway clips this towards deep square leg and they take a brace with ease.

It looks like there is some issue with the landing area of the bowler. Kyle Mayers is indicating that his front foot is not landing well. The ground staff is in with a big stone cube to flatten the area. Everthing seems to fine now and we are ready to continue.
WIDE! Kyle Mayers serves this really wide down leg side. Devon Conway does not bother with it and is called wide by the umpire.
Bowls this back of a length and serves it outside off, Finn Allen is happy to let this one through to the keeper. A maiden wicket for Jason Holder!
Jason Holder bowls a short delivery and angling down leg, Finn Allen goes to pull but misses.
Devon Conway walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Good start for West Indies here! They have got the danger man Martin Guptill early! Jason Holder goes full and just outside off, takes some pace of the ball and Martin Guptill is early into his lofted shot. He skies this high into the air towards mid off, Shamarh Brooks back paddles and takes a comfortable catch. Jason Holder draws first blood!
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Goes a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Martin Guptill clips this towards mid-wicket.
This is a touch wider outside off but still on a good length. Martin Guptill taps this towards cover-point.
Jason Holder is bowling good length here and serves this outside off, Martin Guptill knocks this towards cover.

FOUR! Lucky boundary but four nonetheless! Kyle Mayers goes full this time and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen looks to heave this leg side but manages an inside edge that flies towards the deep square leg boundary to add four runs to his kitty.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside the off stump. Finn Allen defends this back down the pitch.
Back-of-a-length delivery this time, and outside off, Finn Allen goes for the pull but gets beaten.
Kyle Mayers goes slightly full and outside off, Finn Allen goes to loft this over mid on. He does not get a hold of this but just manages to clear the fielder for a couple of runs.
Bowls this on a good length and angling in from outside off stump, Finn Allen defends this firmly back to the bowler.
Kyle Mayers strays onto the pads from a good length, Martin Guptill clips this towards fine leg and takes an easy single.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole. Finn Allen fends this back down the pitch.
Angling into the pads from a good length, Finn Allen misses his flick and the ball hits his pads.
FOUR! New Zealand get their first boundary! Jason Holder bowls this a touch short and gives the batter width. Finn Allen gets on top of the ball and knocks it to deep point for four runs.
A fraction full but still outside off, Finn Allen knocks this towards short cover.
This is wide outside off from a good length, Finn Allen taps this towards backward point.
Jason Holder begins with a good-length delivery just outside off, Finn Allen defends this to the right of the bowler.
Jason Holder will share the attack with Kyle Mayers.
Pulls his length back a bit and around off, Martin Guptill lets it go to the keeper.
Full again and outside off, Martin Guptill this time leaves it alone.
Full and outside off, Martin Guptill goes for the drive to the off side but inside edges it towards mid on.
Straying onto the pads this time and on a good length, Martin Guptill clips this towards deep square leg and takes a brace.
Continues bowling on a good length but closer to the stumps this time, Martin Guptill clips this towards mid-wicket.
Kyle Mayers bowls this on a good length and outside off, Martin Guptill knocks this towards cover.

We are ready for play! The umpires and the players are out in the middle and the Windies team can be seen in a huddle. The Kiwi opening pair of Finn Allen and Martin Guptill also makes their way to the middle. Kyle Mayers has been handed the new ball and is raring to go. Just before the first ball is bowled, the Windies players take the knee to show their support for the BLM movement.

Tom Latham, the stand-in skipper of New Zealand says that Kane Williamson has little bit of niggle and it is precaution to keep him out today. He says that they need to improve their batting and the key is to build partnerships. Informs that Glenn Phillips replaces Kane Williamson and James Neesham comes in for Lockie Ferguson.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies says they are are going to have a bowl since it is the same wicket today. Claims that they will try to restrict New Zealand to a low score if it is possible. Says that it is about staying in the game as long as possible and winning the key moments. Adds the bowlers have to be discplined and be consistent in bowling in the right areas. Informs that everyone did well in the first game and they will be looking to repeat that effort. Informs that Brandon King is back today in place of Jermaine Blackwood.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Devon Conway, Glenn Phillips (In for Kane Williamson), Tom Latham (C) (WK), Daryl Mitchell, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee, James Neesham (In for Lockie Ferguson), Trent Boult.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Kyle Mayers, Shamarh Brooks, Keacy Carty, Nicholas Pooran (C), Brandon King (In for Jermaine Blackwood), Jason Holder, Akeal Hosein, Yannic Cariah, Alzarri Joseph, Kevin Sinclair.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.
We have some news coming in from the Blackcaps official Twitter handle. Kane Williamson is set to miss today's game due to a quad injury. Tom Latham will lead the side in his absence.
